title: Built a lightweight tool to track US equities, Indian markets and global macro without opening 10 tabs during the workday
author: vishyglabs

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
Native currency per market matters more than it sounds. Most trackers silently convert and then nothing you see reconciles against your actual broker statement.

What I would watch is that an always visible ticker increases how often you look rather than reducing it. The flipping just moves into your peripheral vision.

replies.author: vishyglabs
replies.body: 100% on the native currency point. Silent FX conversion drives me nuts because your broker statement never matches what the screen shows, so keeping everything strictly in its native currency ($, ₹, £, ¥) was a day-one rule. And super fair call on the peripheral vision thing ticker anxiety is so real lol. I actually baked in a quick toggle to hide the tape completely, plus domain blacklists so it doesn’t bug you on work sites like Notion or Docs. That way it's not flashing red and green in your face when you're trying to lock in.
